title: Read a short chord name
summary: Read a root letter and the minor sign.

steps.title: A name you can write
steps.body:
**chord symbol** means a short written name for a chord. The capital letter names its root. A letter alone means major: C means C major. Add a small m for minor: Am means A minor, and Cm means C minor.

**Why it matters:** A short name tells you which sounds to put together without writing every note. We will use these names on the coming shape pictures.

steps.title: Read C, then Am
steps.body: C asks for C, E and G. Am asks for A, C and E. The letter gives the root; m tells you to use the minor recipe you just learned.

steps.title: Say the names aloud
steps.body: Say C major when you see C, and A minor when you see Am. Try C, E, G together, then A, C, E. Clear selected positions with Escape between chords.
